title: Broken "Ignore Older" setting in in_tail plugin
body:
## Bug Report

**Describe the bug**
"Ignore older" setting doesn't work at runtime, only at start, after version 2.1.8.

**To Reproduce**
- Steps to reproduce the problem:
1) Set in_tail plugin to collect logs with Ignore_Older=1h
2) Start fluent-bit

**Expected behavior**
After 2h of work Fluent-bit keeps open only current file and file from previous hour.

**Screenshots**
![Clipboard - 20, 2024 11_01](https://github.com/fluent/fluent-bit/assets/51132430/951b7b4e-a7b9-416d-86b6-de18a6ab6f9f)


**Your Environment**
<!--- Include as many relevant details about the environment you experienced the bug in -->
* Version used: 3.0.6
* Configuration: build from source with kafka out plugin
* Operating System and version: windows server 2019

**Additional context**
I noticed that Fluentbit doesn't release old log files, so I used the "Ignore older" setting to reduce the number of open files, because when I have around 1000 logs per 24h, Fluent-Bit uses a lot of RAM (more than 1 GB, which is a lot for an agent). Unfortunately I can't reduce the number of log files. After v2.1.8, this setting doesn't work at runtime.

comments.author: participant1
comments.body: @participant5 @participant9 Could you please help us understand if this is indeed a bug or a misconfiguration? Problem is that basically fluent-bit stops working (and memory is increasing rapidly until it stop working) in case multiple static files are added on a directory which is monitored.

comments.author: participant3
comments.body:
@participant1 if we have set e.g. ignore_older: 15m then we expect the any file matching the Path :

-  is **not** being opened for tailing  on fluent-bit start when it is older than ignore_older
-  is opened for tailing on fluent-bit start when file is younger that ignore_older
-  is **closed and tailing stopped** once the file is not updated within ignore_older time period

Please correct me if I'am wrong.

What we are observing is that fluent-bit process is keeping open files even if they are not updated for longer time. It results in 'Too many open files' error.

comments.author: participant1
comments.body:
> @participant1 if we have set e.g. ignore_older: 15m then we expect the any file matching the Path :
> 
> * is **not** being opened for tailing  on fluent-bit start when it is older than ignore_older
> * is opened for tailing on fluent-bit start when file is younger that ignore_older
> * is **closed and tailing stopped** once the file is not updated within ignore_older time period
> 
> Please correct me if I'am wrong.
> 
> What we are observing is that fluent-bit process is keeping open files even if they are not updated for longer time. It results in 'Too many open files' error.

Your expectation is correct and matching also my expectation. Currently it seems that in_tail keep still the old files opened and this leads to "too many open files" issue. There is a workaround/mitigation that we have in place: kill -s SIGHUP <<fluent-bit pid>>. This way, fluent-bit reloads the configuration and release files that are older than ignore_older. You may try if something like this works also on your environment/use-case but in the end of the day is just a workaround.


**Here is what we did:**
Start FB with -Y (hot-reload) option
```
fluent-bit -i tail -p path='./harvested_folder/*.aud' -p ignore_older=4m -p parser.conf -l fb.log -v -Y
```
Once we have seen in fb.log that harvested files are being ignored because they became older than 4 minutes limit set, see (ignore_older) , then we checked that FB process still keeps them, which confirms this bug, see lsof command. After that we did hot reload, see ```kill -s SIGHUP $(pidof fluent-bit)``` and then we checked again lsof. There were no (zero) previously kept files by the FB process.


```
tail fb.log
[2024/10/25 02:36:39] [debug] [input:tail:tail.0] excluded=./harvested_folder/2024-10-25__02-20-50-461_file99.aud (ignore_older)
[2024/10/25 02:36:39] [debug] [input:tail:tail.0] excluded=./harvested_folder/2024-10-25__02-20-50-467_file100.aud (ignore_older)
[2024/10/25 02:36:39] [debug] [input:tail:tail.0] 0 new files found on path './harvested_folder/*.aud'

date; lsof -p $(pidof fluent-bit) | grep \.aud | wc -l
Fri Oct 25 02:37:04 CEST 2024
       100

kill -s SIGHUP $(pidof fluent-bit)

date; lsof -p $(pidof fluent-bit) | grep \.aud | wc -l
Fri Oct 25 02:38:39 CEST 2024
       0
```
